component.name: Popyachsa AirPlay
component.summary: AirPlay receiver — mirror iPhone, iPad or Mac to your screen

description.p: A low-latency AirPlay receiver. Mirror your iPhone, iPad or Mac, or stream video, photos and music, straight to this computer over your local Wi-Fi.

ul.li: Low-latency screen mirroring with hardware H.264 / H.265 decode (VA-API or NVDEC)
Direct HLS playback for YouTube, Photos, Safari and Apple TV+ video
Auto screen-orientation tracking; window adapts to the picture aspect
A tiny tray app — 16 languages, no accounts, no telemetry

description.p: Pick which network adapter the receiver uses. Runs again on CPUs without AVX. Many fixes to options that could crash or silently misconfigure the receiver.
H.265 and 4K fixes: mirroring no longer drops on reconnect. Auto-updater fixes.
Noticeably sharper video on HiDPI and fractional-scaling displays.
The fullscreen shortcut no longer fires while another app is focused. About links to the source code.
Settings are saved atomically, so nothing is lost if the machine crashes mid-save. Hardened the signed auto-updater.
Cross-platform release: Linux build, settings and self-update.
